title: Three Consecutive Odds
summary: Determine if an integer array contains three consecutive odd numbers; return true if so, otherwise return false.
statement: Determine if an integer array contains three consecutive odd numbers; return true if so, otherwise return false.
constraints: Return true if some three adjacent array values are all odd.
Negative odd values count as odd.
hints: Track the current adjacent odd run length.
Increment for an odd value and reset to zero for an even value.
Return as soon as the run reaches three.
The counter equals the length of the odd suffix ending at each position.
editorial: The counter equals the length of the odd suffix ending at each position.

tests.explanation: There is only one odd value at the end, so no run of three exists.
The first three adjacent values are all odd.
